sources.excerpt: Current restaurant-controlled US menu exposes food, kids, sides and sauces, nonalcoholic beverages, and party platters and links the Nutrition Info service in its footer.
Chili's restaurant-controlled menu footer links this Chili's-branded Nutritionix landing page as NUTRITION INFO, establishing Nutritionix as the restaurant-linked nutrition/allergen vendor.
Chili's states at product level that menu items may contain or contact major allergens and that shared oil, equipment, and surfaces prevent a guarantee that items are allergen-free.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: Chili's says menu items may contain or contact wheat, eggs, shellfish, tree nuts, milk, and other major allergens, and that common oil frying plus shared equipment and surfaces means no item can be guaranteed completely allergen-free.
Chili's asks guests with a food allergy to contact the restaurant to order and notify the team.

findings.summary: Chili's official US menu links the current Chili's-branded Nutritionix guide. Its live unfiltered view returns 275 products and nine contains-filter views supply item-level direct positives.
The official shared-oil, equipment, and surfaces warning is retained at restaurant level and is not smeared into all 275 item mayContain arrays.
Nutritionix contains-filter positives are preserved. Items with no returned positive are marked direct-source unavailable rather than represented as proven free of the screened allergens.
Eight frozen unsized sauce/dressing shells are absent from the current guide and are catalog artifacts; current size-specific products remain with direct egg/milk positives where published.

Seven exact products retain the current guide's gluten positive but drop a frozen legacy wheat alias because the live Nutritionix guide publishes a gluten filter, not an item-specific wheat filter. This does not assert wheat absence.

proposedChanges: Replace the 103-row frozen partial boundary with all 275 unique live Nutritionix products across food, kids, sides, sauces, party platters, and nonalcoholic beverages.
Remove eight unsized sauce/dressing artifact shells and retain their current size-specific products.
Preserve only item-level positives returned by the current Nutritionix contains filters; mark 79 products with no found positive as direct-source unavailable rather than allergen-free.
Retain Chili's shared-oil, equipment, and surfaces warning at restaurant level without smearing it into item mayContain arrays.
Drop seven unsupported frozen item-level wheat aliases while preserving their direct current gluten positives and the separate restaurant-level wheat contact warning.
